The operator approved one governed eval-rst island at docs/reference/index.md, admitted only when its absolute path and complete file bytes match the frozen source.
limitations: Every other eval-rst use and every authored .rst file remains refused.

summary: Select one byte-exact API-reference RST island.
why: The exact island preserves real Sphinx autodoc and autosummary semantics without maintaining a general RST scanner. Mechanical tests bind the full domain inventory and rendered structure, while path and whole-file identity make the exception fail closed.
